d_ml_015.normalized_query: हैदराबाद के ऑर्डर के लिए औसत डिलीवरी देरी कितने घंटे की है?
d_ml_015.executed_sql:
SELECT 
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (de.occurred_at - o.placed_at)) / 3600 AS delivery_delay_hours
FROM 
    orders o
JOIN 
    fulfillments f ON o.order_id = f.order_id
JOIN 
    delivery_events de ON f.fulfillment_id = de.fulfillment_id
JOIN 
    sellers s ON o.seller_id = s.seller_id
JOIN 
    locations l ON s.location_id = l.location_id
WHERE 
    l.city = 'Hyderabad'
LIMIT 1000;

d_ml_016.executed_sql:
SELECT AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (de.occurred_at - o.placed_at)) / 3600) AS avg_delivery_delay_hours
FROM orders o
JOIN fulfillments f ON o.order_id = f.order_id
JOIN delivery_events de ON f.fulfillment_id = de.fulfillment_id
JOIN locations l ON de.location_id = l.location_id
WHERE l.city_local = 'Pune'
LIMIT 1000;

d_ml_017.normalized_query: पिछले 30 दिनों में कितने ऑर्डर असफल या वापस हुए हैं?
d_ml_017.executed_sql:
SELECT o.order_id, o.placed_at
FROM orders o
LEFT JOIN disputes d ON o.order_id = d.order_id
WHERE o.placed_at :: timestamptz >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
AND (d.status IS NULL OR d.status IN ('failed', 'returned'))
LIMIT 1000;
